create_GPTOssSingleExpert: create a GPTOssSingleExpert module with custom hidden and intermediate sizes for GPT-OSS expert inference
build_SequentialGPTOSSMoE: build a SequentialGPTOSSMoE module from an original GptOssMLP and GptOssConfig to replace fused MoE with per-expert modules
run_materialize_weights: run _materialize_weights on a SequentialGPTOSSMoE instance to copy weights from fused tensors into per-expert MLPs
review_SequentialGPTOSSMoE_forward: review the SequentialGPTOSSMoE forward method that routes tokens through selected experts using router scores and indices
test_from_original: test the from_original classmethod to create a SequentialGPTOSSMoE from an existing GptOssMLP module and config
